identity.title: Grand Gulf Nuclear Station, Unit 1 Licensee Event Report 2024-005-00, Loss of Seal Steam Controller Power Resulted in Manual Reactor Shutdown

cause.proximate_text: The root cause of the event was the determination of the life expectancy of the power supplies with electrolytic capacitors was incorrectly designed using the in-service date as the starting criteria; however, electrolytic capacitors begin degrading upon manufactured date. Starting the life expectancy for this power supply from the in-service date as opposed to manufactured date resulted in the power supply being installed with a projected life expectancy of 10 years when the component already had 6 years of shelf life and only 4 years of remaining life expectancy.
cause.theme: Component life-expectancy determination error (electrolytic capacitor aging basis)

The power supply providing seal steam controller power failed.

Loss of seal steam control led to degraded condenser vacuum.

nodes.display_name: Group 1 containment isolation signal / MSIV closure
Automatic RPS actuation in Mode 3 with all rods inserted
Replace seal steam power supply 1N21K602B and restore seal steam control
Revise maintenance procedure for power supply age determination and evaluation, including Supply Chain contact and Condition Report requirement
